title: Colonic Duplication; Two Cases Report and Review of Literature
brief_summary: Duplicated colon appendix are infrequent detected during surgical exploration. For Diagnosed cases, excision of the duplicated part is indispensable, due to risk of malignancy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Pediatric patients till age of 18 years old
2. All patients diagnosed with duplicated colon with or without symptoms
3. Patients with duplicated colon and other associated colorectal anomalies

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients \> 18 years with duplicated colon
2. All patients with duplication cyst
study_population: Pediatric patients age group from 1 day till 18 years
